description: Converts between a pyrometric cone and its temperature, and between °C and °F. Orton cones run 022 to 42: Glazecalc's figure, from 022 to 15, is Orton's older chart for large cones at 150 °C an hour, and Orton's current figures (self-supporting cones at 15, 60 and 150 °C an hour, large cones at 60 and 150, cone 022 to 14) come beside it; Orton publishes no figure above cone 14, so cones from 16 up have none. SK cones (JIS R 8101, SK 022 to SK 20) by the standard's nominal figures. Give a cone, or a temperature to find the nearest cones.

celsius.description: A temperature in degrees Celsius to convert (-50 to 2000); give a temperature, or a cone instead.

chart.description: Which cone chart to use: "orton" (Orton) or "sk" (SK, JIS R 8101).

cone.description: The pyrometric cone to convert to a temperature (cones run 022 to 42, e.g. "6"); give a cone, or a temperature instead.

fahrenheit.description: A temperature in degrees Fahrenheit to convert (-60 to 3600); give a temperature, or a cone instead.
